verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page says teams can skip its native Pipelines and connect Bitbucket Cloud to on-prem CI/CD tools like Bamboo or Jenkins. It also says third-party code reports appear in PRs, which suggests results from external tools can flow back into review. Missing for 10: setup docs for the integration (build-status reporting, webhooks or API), named support for cloud-hosted CI tools beyond Bamboo/Jenkins, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
